chars.MOM: a Moroccan mother in her late 40s, round face, wearing a mustard-yellow house djellaba, a dark green headscarf and blue plastic slippers
chars.SON: a skinny Moroccan young man about 20, messy black curly hair, white tank top and red basketball shorts
chars.GIRL: a Moroccan young woman about 20, long loose black hair, oversized lavender hoodie and grey sweatpants

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Early morning at the front door inside an old stone house in a popular neighbourhood of Sale, Morocco, seen from halfway up the staircase: MOM pretends to leave, handbag on her arm and hand on the door, but secretly hides a long wooden stick behind her back and glances sideways up toward the stairs with a sly suspicious look. Head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, comic tense mood, 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside an old stone house in Sale: two little school kids with backpacks run out the front door, while MOM quietly tiptoes up the narrow staircase toward the rooftop, gripping a long wooden stick, finger to her lips, determined face. 2D animated cartoon style, warm morning light.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Old rooftop of a stone house in Sale with laundry lines: a small open-front storage room with a thin mattress on the floor. MOM bursts in at the doorway raising a long wooden stick, furious wide eyes, while SON wakes up startled on the mattress, blanket pulled up. Comic shocked mood, 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside the small rooftop storage room in Sale: MOM chases GIRL around the mattress waving a long wooden stick like a broom, GIRL ducks with her hands over her head, SON still half asleep sitting up confused in the background. Slapstick comedy, no blood, 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: On the old rooftop of a stone house in Sale: SON runs barefoot toward the closed wooden rooftop door, covering his head with both arms, panicked comic face, MOM behind him in the background waving the wooden stick. 2D animated cartoon style, morning light.
